verdicts.why: Raina brings Cal a picture of Skye and tells him she has found his daughter in AoS S1E22, so the stage starts there.
Reyes betrays Coulson, hijacks the Bus and ends the episode in S.H.I.E.L.D. custody. Fandom lists Coulson under her enemies, so 'enemy' fits where 0-8-4 leaves them.

value.title: Luke Cage S1#1
value.text: Candace Miller waits tables at Cottonmouth's club, Harlem's Paradise, and is too scared to bring him drinks alone.

verdicts.why: Candace asks Luke to go up with her because she is scared to bring Cottonmouth drinks in LC S1E1, and he is dead by S1E8. The framing sentence (S1E8) is cut so the earlier stage does not spoil his death; it belongs on her Mariah or Luke stage.
Candace tells Misty that Mariah killed Cottonmouth and asks for protection in exchange for testimony (S1E12); Shades kills her (S1E13). Nothing says she was to testify against Diamondback.
In AoS S2E1 Creel already works as Whitehall's brainwashed assassin, and on his orders he goes after Talbot and takes the Obelisk from the crash site.
Talbot is a United States Air Force general, and the soldiers who arrest Creel in S2E1 are Air Force.
In S3E12 Jemma questions Creel in a containment module, and he then joins the mission as Talbot's bodyguard. Fandom lists Jemma under his allies, and nothing hostile happens between them.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Carl Creel attacks Isabelle Hartley's team and nearly kills Lance Hunter, then causes the crash that kills Hartley.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hartley's teammate, nearly killed by Creel in the crash that kills her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Hartley's killer, who nearly kills Hunter too.

verdicts.why: The Browning fight and the crash that kills Hartley and Idaho are in S2E1. Hunter's revenge hunt is S2E2, so it is cut here to avoid a spoiler; it needs its own S2#2 stage.
The Talbot ambush, May's kick and Skye's taser shot are in S2E1, before Creel kills Hartley's team later that episode. The new text has the order right.
In S2E1 Creel reports to Bakshi after killing Browning and gets musgravite from Whitehall through him.

In S5E14 Creel stands by Hale as Coulson is forced to free her, insists Daisy shot Talbot, and listens as the captive Coulson says he is on the wrong side. That is an opposing-sides turn between the S3#12 and S5#16 ally stages.

value.title: Daredevil S1#1
value.text: Christian Blake and Carl Hoffman are partners and best friends on the force.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hoffman's partner and best friend on the force.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Blake's partner and best friend on the force.

verdicts.why: Blake and Hoffman already work Karen Page's case as partners in DD S1E1. The killing on Fisk's orders is S1E8, so it is cut here; it needs its own S1#8 stage.
By the end of Captain Marvel, Minn-Erva has shot at Carol and then tries to shoot down the Quadjet carrying Carol's friends, and Maria kills her. That is open enmity, not rivalry.

In The Marvels, Carol stops the Kree guard about to strike Muneeba and Yusuf. Muneeba tells Kamala she will kill Carol if anything happens to her, and the Khans help Carol move. No scene has Carol asking Muneeba for help.
Wolf orders Madani off the Zubair case in Punisher S1E1 and dies in S1E2, so the stage cannot start in S1E3.

value.title: The Punisher S1#1
value.text: Carson Wolf is Sam Stein's boss at Homeland Security, and his dislike for Stein leaves him stuck at a desk in a hallway.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Wolf dislikes and keeps stuck at a hallway desk.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Stein's boss, who dislikes him and keeps him at a hallway desk.

verdicts.why: Wolf's dislike, Stein's hallway desk and Wolf ordering him out of the room are all in S1E1. The autopsy and the hidden millions come after Wolf's S1E2 death (S1E3), so they are cut here and need their own stage.
In Loki S2E2 B-15 checks on Casey's search for Renslayer's TemPad and brings him to the Temporal Loom room to help Ouroboros.
Casey meets Ouroboros, realizes he wrote the TVA Guidebook and asks for an autograph, then works with him on the reset charges, all in S2E2.
In S2E2 Casey tracks Renslayer and agrees to analyze X-5's altered TemPad for Loki and the others.

Paradox never brings Nova out. He tells his sleeper agent Pyro to kill her. Nova reads the plot from Pyro, comes through a Sling Ring portal, kills Pyro, accuses Paradox, puts her fingers in his skull and forces him to start the Time Ripper.
In Echo E2 Maya has a vision of her ancestors, and Skully tells her one of the women was Chafa, the first Choctaw.
In E3 the vision of Chafa and Lowak tells Tuklo the Lighthorsemen are in trouble. She finds them ambushed (not captured) and shoots the attackers until all are dead.
In AoS S1E5 Raina names Chan Scorch while only using him. He is captured, injected and drained for Centipede's serum, and fandom lists Raina among his enemies.
Xavier believes Stephen, tells him where the Book of Vishanti is and dies fighting the Scarlet Witch. Fandom lists Stephen among his allies.
Blake and Hoffman hold Karen Page in the Daniel Fisher case, and Matt and Foggy get her released, in DD S1E1.
The 2007 fireside night with Taloa and William, the drive when Chula senses trouble and learns Taloa is dead, and the later breakup are all in Echo E1.

Claire comforts Colleen over Bakuto after he slashes her in The Defenders E5, a later title. In Iron Fist S1E11 Claire confronts Colleen about the Hand but lets her in, and she keeps training with her in S1E13.
After Luke punches through her wall in LC S2E3 'Wig Out', Claire tells him to go and says she needs a break. Leaving the note in S2E4 only follows the breakup.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#8
value.text: Claire goes with Danny and Colleen to China, where Madame Gao sends her men to attack them, and they take Gao prisoner.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader who sends her men at Claire, then is taken prisoner.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A nurse who comes with Danny to China and helps fight Gao's men.

verdicts.why: The Anzhou fight and Gao's capture are in IF S1E8. Guarding her and giving the truth serum are S1E9, so they are cut here to avoid a spoiler.

value.title: Daredevil S1#2
value.text: Claire Temple is the nurse who finds Matt bleeding in a dumpster, and she keeps patching him up as the masked vigilante.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A masked vigilante Claire found bleeding in a dumpster and keeps patching up.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The nurse who found Matt in a dumpster and keeps patching him up.

verdicts.why: Claire finds Matt in the dumpster in DD S1E2. Their kiss and the talk where they settle on friendship come later in S1, so they are cut here and need their own later stage. That stage is the old S1#11 one.
Cherry and Kirsten visit Soledad Ayala together, and Cherry finds the White Tiger suit, in Born Again S1E2. Their work on the Ayala case starts there.
Clint wins the Ronin suit back from Grills in the Central Park LARP duel in Hawkeye E2, tells Grills to call him by name and bumps fists with him.
In Born Again S2E8 North refuses Powell's order to shoot Cherry, Mahoney and Kim, knocks Powell out, takes command and lets the police and protesters into the courthouse.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#6
value.text: Mayor Fisk recruits Sergeant Cole North and his fellow officers into his new Anti-Vigilante Task Force.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor who recruits North into his Anti-Vigilante Task Force.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A sergeant Fisk recruits into his Anti-Vigilante Task Force.

verdicts.why: Fisk recruits North and Powell at the fleet services shop in S1E6. Taking credit for Muse is S1E7, so that line is cut here.
Fisk recruits Powell, North and the other officers into the Anti-Vigilante Task Force in Born Again S1E6.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#2
value.text: Connor Powell is present when his partner Kel Shanahan dies in a fight with Hector Ayala, and he arrests Hector for murder.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Powell's partner dies in a fight with him. Powell arrests him for murder.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The officer who arrests Hector after his partner's death.

verdicts.why: The subway fight, Shanahan's death and the arrest at gunpoint are in S1E2. Powell's false testimony is at the S1E3 trial, so it is cut here and needs its own stage.

value.title: The Defenders#3
value.text: Colleen Wing hosts the meeting at her dojo where Luke Cage and Danny Rand settle their first fight and agree to work together.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A hero Colleen brings together with Danny at her dojo.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who hosts Luke's truce with Danny at her dojo.

verdicts.why: Claire has Colleen arrange the Luke and Danny meeting at the Chikara Dojo in Defenders E3. Fighting beside Luke against the Hand comes later (E5 onward), so that sentence is cut.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#8
value.text: Colleen travels with Danny and Claire to Anzhou to confront Madame Gao, who sends her men at them, and they take Gao prisoner.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader Colleen helps confront and capture in Anzhou.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fighter who comes with Danny to Anzhou and helps take Gao prisoner.

verdicts.why: The Anzhou confrontation and Gao's capture are in IF S1E8. Colleen's tie to the Hand through Bakuto is not revealed until S1E10, so it is cut here and needs its own S1#10 stage.
Phillips recruiting Howard after showing him the Guernica footage comes from the tie-in comic Captain America: First Vengeance. The film only shows Howard already working under Phillips in the SSR.
Peggy rescuing Erskine from Castle Kaufmann comes from First Vengeance, not the film. In The First Avenger she helps Steve go after the 107th against Phillips's orders.
Connie chases Luke for late rent, and he throws out Zip's gang when they lean on the Lins for Mariah's money, both cited to LC S1E1.
The Northern Star, carrying Fisk's weapons shipment, is boarded in Born Again S2E1, where Savva is first mate.
In S2E4 Savva gives a recorded deposition naming the Kingpin, whom he knows is the mayor, and Buck Cashman then kills him. Fandom lists Fisk under his enemies.
Mariah is with Cottonmouth at Harlem's Paradise in LC S1E1, discussing her campaign money. The killing (S1E7) is correctly moved to its own stage.
Mariah kills Cornell in a rage in LC S1E7 after he taunts her.
